page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. Running head top right, page number top left. Lines of Greek verb forms with centred tense headings, then an italic heading, more verb-form lines, and a Latin paragraph at the foot. Catchword bottom right.

page.notes: The Greek is printed in a small, heavy type with many accents, and several forms are blurred at the scan resolution. Accents and the exact letters of the verb forms are doubtful throughout; each doubtful form is marked [?] where it stands. The line "Τύπτεσαι: ..." in the Præsens section is only partly readable: the first word is clear, the rest is approximate. The right-hand margin is cut off at the scan edge; no marginal notes are visible. The catchword "Quo" is set in a swash hand and is read from the image. Printed spellings such as "medię", "formę", "utranq;" and "actívā" are kept as they appear.
